options.chromalight.enabled.tooltip: Colored light on blocks, fluids and entities.
options.chromalight.tint_strength.toolti: How strongly light sources tint the world. Applies immediately.
options.chromalight.source_blend.tooltip: Mixes light from nearby sources of different colors. At 0% every spot takes the color of its brightest source. This is the setting that costs the most CPU when chunks rebuild. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.auto_colors.tooltip: Light sources without a color in the config or a light pack get one from their texture: the brightest, most colorful part of it. Grey and white textures stay uncolored. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.max_mixed_sources.to: How many differently colored sources can mix at one spot. Little performance difference between 2 and 8. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.max_realtime_sources: How many animated colors (rainbow, flicker, colors set by commands or other mods) one chunk section can show. Any number of blocks can share one color. Extra colors stop animating until the section rebuilds. 0 turns animation off. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.flicker.tooltip: Torches, campfires, fire, candles and lanterns flicker. Only the brightness changes; light levels and mob spawning stay vanilla. The block list is flicker_blocks in the config. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.flicker_strength.too: How deep the flame dips. Applies immediately.
options.chromalight.entity_lighting.tool: Mobs, players, items and particles take the color of the light around them. Entity types in entity_blacklist (config or light packs) are left alone. Applies immediately.
options.chromalight.dynamic_lights.toolt: With LambDynamicLights or Ars Nouveau's dynamic light, held torches, burning mobs, spell projectiles and glowing items light the world in their own color. Rebuilds chunks.
options.chromalight.sky_light.tooltip: Daylight is slightly warm, sunrise and sunset are orange, moonlight is blue. Only the color changes; brightness and light levels stay vanilla. Colors are sky_day, sky_dusk, sky_night in the config or /chromalight sky. Applies immediately.
options.chromalight.sky_strength.tooltip: How strongly time of day and weather tint sky light. Applies immediately.
options.chromalight.sky_weather.tooltip: Rain makes sky light grey-blue, thunderstorms darker blue. Colors are sky_rain and sky_thunder in the config. Applies immediately.
commands.chromalight.bloodmoon.day: The blood moon will rise at nightfall
commands.chromalight.bloodmoon.disabled: Blood moon is on, but ChromaLight is disabled
